- Added product tour in the settings menu.
- Added 'Help / Report a bug...' and 'Documentation' buttons in the settings menu.
- Made automation dropdown slightly more visible.
- Moved measure numbers slightly closer to the line it represents

- Added a 7 day free trial. This is packaged directly inside the same .dmg file.
- Removed dreamy haze and hacker themes
- Added an experimental screen export feature
- Plugins sort in alphabetical order
- Fixed manual sync not working for phone as webcam
- Added a search menu when you right click an effect
- Changed 'FX' tab to FX/Plugins

- Fixed licensing issue
- Fixed small keychain bug

- Hardened export 
- Fixed common bugs
- Fixed frozen playhead bug
Phone/WebRTC recording and MP4 export remain experimental.

Test
Phone/WebRTC recording and MP4 export remain experimental.

VisiDAW 0.2.5

Signed universal macOS release for Apple Silicon and Intel, targeting macOS 12 or later.

This release uses the STABLE Sparkle update feed and production Polar licensing. A valid VisiDAW license and an internet connection are required for initial activation; an accepted saved activation supports offline use. Existing production activations retain the same licensing identity.

Includes the standard Sparkle update interface and the shared save/quit handling used by normal quit and update installation. TESTING installations remain on their own feed; install this STABLE app to use the customer update channel.

Phone/WebRTC recording and MP4 export remain experimental.
